title: Amor y Engaño
description: Raúl Quijas era un médico ginecólogo. Durante una cirugía de aborto en el hospital de maternidad e infantil al que fue enviado como apoyo, descubrió inesperadamente que la mujer en la operación era su propia esposa, Maite López. Resultó que la esposa con quien había prometido pasar el resto de su vida ya había cambiado de corazón y le había sido infiel con otra persona.

title: Mi fiera y su malcriado
description: El emperador ordena a Marian casarse con el príncipe Harlan. Tras ser traicionada y envenenada por él y su prima, Marian renace el día del decreto. Con esta segunda oportunidad, rechaza a Harlan y elige a Julian, el infame mujeriego de la capital.

title: Renacer y convertirse en leyenda
description: Carson, último heredero del Linaje Imperial Ascendente, es traicionado y obligado a autodestruirse por los Tres Señores Supremos. Tras renacer a los 20 años con sus recuerdos intactos, jura vengarse. Con la ayuda de Víctor Yates y su familia, Carson desenmascara a su ex manipuladora, aplasta a élites arrogantes y derrota al Gran Maestro Cyrus. En su ascenso al poder, se convierte en la figura más temida de Newhaven, listo para reclamar su lugar en la cima.

title: Kokoro y el viento del otoño
Me echas, y pierdes
description: Elena Morales, antes protegida y diseñadora principal de la poderosa Familia Muñoz, es despojada de todo y expulsada tras ser traicionada por su prometido, Javier Muñoz, quien elige a Aurora Cardona en su lugar. Humillada y sin nada, Elena recibe una oportunidad inesperada de Luciano Cifuentes, heredero de la rival Familia Cifuentes, y pronto se convierte en su diseñadora principal. Años después, al alcanzar la cima junto al Grupo Cifuentes, Javier descubre sus errores y que Elena siempre fue su verdadera salvadora. Las mentiras de Aurora salen a la luz, el imperio Muñoz se derrumba, y Elena encuentra el amor y la confianza en Luciano. Su boda apasionada es sacudida por un atentado relacionado con el mundo criminal. Entre intrigas y traiciones, Elena emerge firme y decidida a vivir en libertad.

title: Pétalos de rosa y resurrección
description: El heredero de la familia más rica llevaba tres años en coma. Los mejores médicos fracasaron. Entonces llegó ella: una mendiga. Hubo risas, burlas y espadas desenvainadas. Ella no se inmutó. Un movimiento. Un roce. Silencio total. «Preparen un baño. Agua caliente y pétalos de rosa en cada rincón. ¿Y ese chico lindo?», dijo señalando al heredero. «Tráiganmelo».

title: Camarón: The Film
description: The life of Camarón de la Isla. From his humble gipsy origins to international stardom.

title: Balas y Diamantes
description: "Balas y Diamantes" cuenta la historia de una joven asiática secuestrada en su país de origen cuando era casi una niña y vendida junto a otras muchachas a un traficante en México quien no sólo las prostituyó, pero además, entrenó a algunas para que robaran para él. La joven logra fugarse con un botín de diamantes y escapar de México con la ayuda de un antiguo amante.

title: Entre Cunas y Mentiras
description: El mismo día dos mejores amigas dan a luz. Pero Astrid, que nació en la pobreza, cambia en secreto a su bebé por la de su amiga CEO, con la esperanza de darle a su hija una vida de lujo. Lo que no espera es que la CEO lo vea todo y cambie discretamente a las bebés de nuevo. 18 años más tarde, justo cuando el plan de Astrid está a punto de tener éxito, descubre la impactante verdad: la hija a la que ha maltratado todos estos años, es suya.

title: Mamá y Sus Tres Cupidos
description: Seis años después, Tiana regresa con tres hijos y un anillo de diamantes dejado por un misterioso hombre. Al buscar a su padre, los niños pierden el anillo.

title: ¿Cortar Lazos, Prosperar y Llorar?
description: Obrera Qi Lanzhi malcrió a su hijo Qin Yu tras perder a su hija. Él derrocha dinero pero la desprecia. Al intentar abandonarla, descubre que la CEO que atropelló a su madre es su hermana perdida. Juntas reforman a este "hijo inútil

title: El Director y el Fantasma
description:
El Director y el fantasma

Es una historia basada en la vida de un director de cine Hugo al cual su vida cambio repentinamente con la violenta muerta de su hija Lucy y la traición de su esposa Lina. Envuelto en la desesperación , la soledad y depresion se refugia en una casa antigua que pertenecia a sus padres. Apoyado únicamente por su mejor amigo y productor de sus películas Alan, Hugo busca ayuda en la iglesia donde el Padre Isaac lo trata de ayudar espiritualmente y buscando una ayuda psicológica lo recomienda al Dr. Ivan Luna.

Dentro de la soledad, frustacion, impotencia y depresión crea una realidad paralela a su realidad actual. Por la influencia del Dr. Luna, Hugo cambia completamente su vida y la de los demás, donde les hara sentir que a la miseria no le gusta estar sola.

title: Miércoles, Muros, Celdas y Puertas Entreabiertas
When His Loyalty Hit Zero
description: Mia can see a loyalty score floating above every head. Her childhood sweetheart Jack was a perfect hundred for six years—until jealousy slid in and the number started falling. When he tilts toward the girl he calls his sunshine, Mia doesn't cry or beg. She walks. Picking up running for herself, she's drawn to quiet Ethan, whose hundred never wavered since the day she pulled him into a P.E. group years ago. Jack sinks as he begs, tailgates, and schemes to win her back, but Mia won't chase empties anymore. She chose the one whose number never dropped.

title: WHO AM I? (The Documentary)
description: One question seeker's have asked for eternity, it has been humanity's deepest inquiry, it is a quest "Who am i?" and what your own unique answer is to that is what this film is aiming to stir open for everyone including the questioner, the speaker, and the viewer in an immersive and experiential manner. Documentary = truth telling, this film is doing exactly that, and it's letting the truth be experienced not just being told. Unless anything is experienced it is never fully accepted. Over 100 people from varied walks of life, age, professions, parts of the world, and strata of society all answer this one question who am i? There is no right or wrong or judgment but a clear witnessing of our human journey both as individuals and as a collective. The one question that really steers the direction of this film is - can this primary question that is being asked in the film really be answered and is there any cookie cutter formula where there can be 1 correct and definitive answer given and then one could either self-validate or begin to strive towards it as humans, we are conditioned to seek this easy way out, so is there one for this question too?

description: Lindy, an innocent girl reared in a small town, accepts a letter for her friend Mrs. Bates from wealthy landlady Mrs. Cribbley. Lindy's greatest admirer is reformed thief Dick Ross, who is now Mrs. Cribbley's secretary. His former partner-in-crime, "Doc" Brogan, robs Mrs. Cribbley's house, but she suspects a tramp called Chilowee Bill. Lindy erroneously thinks that her theft has been discovered, and when she befriends Chilowee Bill, Dick mistakenly assumes that she is in league with the robbers. He loses his incentive to reform and joins forces with Doc and Lindy. Although Dick plans to rob Mr. Meekton, Chilowee Bill does it first, leading Doc to suspect that he has been double-crossed. title: The White Olive Tree
description: In turbulent Dongguo, reporter Song Ran meets demolition engineer Li Zan. Their shared ideals spark romance, cut short by an explosion. Back home, they face guilt until reuniting to plant olive seeds, symbolizing recovery.

title: Marriage of Convenience: I Wed My First Love, The Pilot
description: Nora has loved Ethan since he stood up for her in high school. Ten years later, she's an air traffic controller, he's a pilot, and a blind date reunites them. When Ethan proposes a marriage of convenience, Nora agrees, keeping her feelings to herself. But after she guides his plane through a storm, a jealous colleague tries to destroy her career and their marriage. Can Nora clear her name and tell Ethan what she's kept secret for a decade?

title: The Mafia's Accidental Queen
description: Eun-soo gets unexpectedly pregnant due to a medical mix-up. Her initial shock is short-lived when she discovers the father of her unborn child is the ruthless Mafia King, Gio. Though he is a dangerous man who brutally kills his enemies, Eun-soo's heart begins to waver as she sees Gio risk his own life to shield her and their baby from every threat... Will Eun-soo accept Gio as her baby's father and become the Queen of the Mafia Empire?

title: He Chose Her, I Married the Mafia Don
description: Adrian cancels his wedding for Celeste a third time, certain his “orphan” fiancée will never leave. Then Celeste frames Valentina, Adrian abandons her bleeding in shattered glass, and Valentina disappears. What he never knew is that she is the Romano crime family’s princess. Back in her father’s empire, she agrees to meet Dante Moretti, the ruthless mafia don who offers the respect Adrian never did. As Adrian uncovers Celeste’s betrayal and tears the world apart searching for Valentina, he discovers too late that the woman he took for granted may soon belong to his most dangerous rival.

title: Velayat-e Eshq
description: This is a story about the journey of a philosopher/ religous figure/thinker Imam Ali Reza of the prominent Islamic world at a time when the entire islamic territory was ruled by tyranny. Imam Ali Reza stood up against the tyrants with nothing more than non violence. This tale captures the journey of him and how he captured millions of hearts.

title: Juventude e Ternura
description: Involved in the illegal sale of whiskey, an outlaw is charmed by a singer. He shows interest in managing the girl and, in fact, makes her known throughout the country. The young woman, however, is in love with a composer.

title: Aarzu e Mann
description: Aarzu-e-Mann is a love story set in scenic San Francisco, about a Pakistani-American girl, Samira, who is born in a wealthy and politically connected Shah family. Her falling in love with an American man with a Pakistani American background, makes things complicated, as she struggles to have her conservative and influential father embrace her choice. Being the only child of a wealthy man, other family members are also against her decision and hatch plans to ensure Samira marries within the family. Writer Zulfiqar Talpur weaves an intricate web of stories about expatriates living in the U.S., who hold on to tradition while trying to assimilate in their new homeland.

title: F#@K I Love U
description: F#@k I Love U is a dramatic tale of a modern family that gets quickly pulled into a spiral of interconnected events that test the limits of their bond and mutual love. Douglas Winston is, by all appearances, the perfect family man. A well groomed and successful black politician, he, his wife white Angie, and their two sons, James and Michael, seem to lead idyllic lives that quickly begin to unravel when Douglas visits his brother J, an white irresponsible would be actor with heavy drug and sex habits. After a jeopardizing incident endangers all of their lives, Douglas is quick to blame J and his irresponsible nature, but in trying to delve into the actual truth, the strands that hold his life together quickly start to unravel into a downward spiral of twisted connections, tangled love, and intrigue that will put to the test the true limits of his faith in those he loves and who he believes in.

title: Vice, nawindang sa Miss Q&A! Nanawagan sa DepEd!
description:
Salubungin ang July with champion biritan kasama nina TNT Duets 2 champs Christian Tbayan at Arvery Lagoring. Nagkaisa naman ang mga 'accla' sa Miss Q and A segment. Ang kanilang chika, bawasan ang problema at dagdagan ang saya. Ipinanalo nina Pia Cayetatayno, Mama Dhel, at Samaya Jhay ang protesta kontra bad vibes.

Isa-isang inilatag ng mga kandidata ang mga paandar nilang intro, drawing laughter from the Madlang People in the studio. Si Vice Ganda, may napansin sa tatlong kandidata. Kung si Pia ay may mga matang ala Meryll Soriano, si Mama Dhel naman daw ay mukhang 'baby' na 36 years overdue.

Nang magsimula ang unang round, ang nasabi na lang ni Meme ay, "Diyos ko!" dahil sa sagot ng mga kandidata for today's video. Sa tanong na, "Ano ang plural ng salitang furniture?" sumagot ang isang kandidata, na para bang sure na sure, "Super furnitures."

Kaya si Meme, 'nanginig' at nag-react nang pabiro, "Nananawagan talaga kami sa Department of Education. Gumalaw na tayo."

Sina Mama Dhel at Samaya Jhay ang nagharap sa ikalawang round, Wit Lang. Ang pinusuan ng mga hurado ay si Mama Dhel bilang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra sa araw na 'to.

Pumuti man ang kanilang buhok, nananatili namang makulay ang sense of humor ng mga beloved lolo't lola from Meycauayan, Bulacan na nakisaya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Mga 'veterans' as in veterans sa pagpapatawa naman ang nagsama-sama sa You Gotta Lyric round na bagong inaabangan ng "It's Showtime" fans. Madlang People ay napa-wow nang si Vice Ganda ay lumabas bilang MemeRimar! Aww!

Ang happy ending sa kuwentong 'to ay para kay Tatay Philip, na umabante sa dulo ng laro. Positive lang ang pananaw ni tatay sa buhay. Aniya, pumunta siya sa "It's Showtime" nang walang dala, kaya aalis siyang sapat na ang P30,000 na Li-Pot offer.

title: The S from Hell
description: THE S FROM HELL is a short documentary-cum-horror film about the scariest corporate symbol in history - The 1964 Screen Gems logo, aka 'The S From Hell.' Built around interviews with survivors still traumatized from their childhood exposure to the logo after shows like Bewitched or The Monkees, the film brings their stories to life with animation, found footage, and dramatic reenactments. Not an exhaustive historical documentary, THE S FROM HELL is a subjective film whose aim is make the audience feel the same fear and confusion as the children who were first confronted by the vexing, unfolding sights and mournful, dissonant sounds that hid in the cracks between their favorite TV shows.

title: Pus$y Catz
description: Pus$y Catz follows Lena, Toya, and Semone-three young women navigating survival, ambition, and temptation in the unforgiving streets of Atlanta. When a plan to secure fast money goes wrong, friendships fracture, secrets surface, and dangerous men close in from every direction. As betrayal brews within their own circle, each woman is forced to choose between loyalty, love, and the desperate fight to protect her future. What begins as hustle turns into a high-stakes war of trust, power, and consequences. As the women push deeper into a high-stakes hustle that promises fast cash, their world quickly becomes a maze of scams gone wrong, toxic relationships, manipulation, and revenge. A shady figure from Lena's past reappears, Toya's choices draw unwanted attention, and Semone's loyalty is tested on all sides. The trio begins to fracture, with each woman caught in the crossfire of decisions they can't take back. The tension reaches a breaking point when a setup turns violent, exposing hidden alliances, buried grudges, and a truth that threatens to destroy their bond forever. In a final confrontation where reputations, relationships, and lives hang in the balance, the women must decide: Will they claw their way out together, or tear each other apart? Pus$y Catz Bratz is a gritty, stylish blend of urban drama, betrayal thriller, and character-driven storytelling-where every choice has a cost, and every secret has claws.

title: Al-Khimyah
description: Al-Khimyah explores the work of the Aga Khan Trust for Culture (AKTC) in the historic city of Cairo, Egypt. The film shines a spotlight on the 30-hectare Al-Azhar Park - converted from a mound of rubble - and the stories of local residents of the adjacent al-Darb al-Ahmar neighbourhood. The park has also proven to be a powerful catalyst for urban renewal, evolving beyond the green space itself to include the restoration of monuments and public spaces, and socioeconomic initiatives including housing rehabilitation, microfinance, crafts apprenticeships, and healthcare. Since opening in 2005 after 20 years of careful excavation and design, Al-Azhar Park has provided much-needed leisure and recreational space to the inhabitants of the city, and is today often referred to as "Cairo's green lung."

title: Orson at the Orient
description: Orson at the Orient is the story of a meeting no one admits happened: A bombed city under martial law and powers on the verge of a new war give home to deceit and uncertainty in 1948 Vienna. The city, divided among the allied powers, is also hosting the filming of The Third Man. It's star, American actor Orson Welles is spending his after-hours in the well-known Hotel Orient, soon to be disturbed by Soviet troops led by a young Officer. On his mind only one mission. title: Au pays des colons
description: In the 1930s, in the throes of the Great Depression, the government of Quebec relocated more than 80,000 citizens to found a new settlement in the virgin forests of Quebec's Abitibi region. After enduring backbreaking work to clear the land, however, many left, seeking a better life in the city or as labourers for the large corporations that had come to exploit the North's valuable resources. The Lalancette family, however, have persisted in forging their future on the land from one generation to the next, earning their keep from farming, and defying the constraints of globalization and the mining and forestry companies that control the area. Revisiting the heritage of Quebec filmmakers who documented Abitibi, following in the footsteps of Pierre Perrault, among others, this documentary traces a defining chapter of Quebec history and raises fundamental questions about regional development.

title: Poly au Portugal

Poly soon reappears and leads the children to a wanted man on the run who claims to be searching for his missing son. With the aid of Poly, a fisherman called Faustino and the village children, Pascal, Richard and Mariane set out to solve the mystery. description: After a series of pipe dream ventures go belly up, retired pro soccer player Kim Won-kang happens to visit East Timor, where he finds children playing the game barefoot on rocky pitches. Sensing a new business opportunity on finding the country doesn't have a single sporting goods store, he embarks on a scheme to get rich quick by purveying athletic shoes to the unshod youngsters. Sadly, no one there can afford to pay $60 for a pair of shoes, even on a generous installment plan, and before he knows it, he is reduced to coaching a team of ragged 10-year-olds and prospects are looking grim.

title: Being Fired? Now I'm Out of Their League!
description: Forced into an engagement, Julian follows his grandpa's order, works at Harper Enterprise, secretly making Serena the new Wall Street business queen. But Serena and her assistant Damian drive him out, and the company collapses without him.

title: Deet N Bax Save Th' World
description: Bloody Stoner Odyssey full of Sex, Guns'n Weed.

title: Song-o
description: A group of city dwellers make a trip of three days and two nights into the isolated countryside to visit a friend in the hills. Their true nature begins to reveal itself: love hidden but never forgotten, primitive desires suppressed in the city, nasty pride that triumphs only over the weak and a strong will for survival that sacrifices even love and friendship.

title: O Novo CEO é o Meu Ginecologista (Dublado)
description: Clara vive presa em um casamento sem intimidade e desenvolve hipersexualidade. Em busca de ajuda, ela é humilhada pelo Dr. Killian durante um exame, pouco antes de descobrir a traição do marido. A reviravolta acontece quando o novo CEO da empresa se revela ser o próprio Killian. Ele passa a se aproveitar da condição dela, forçando-a à submissão e levando o relacionamento dos dois ao limite.

title: Ballada o Januszku
description: A single mother, blinded by the love for her trouble-making son Januszek, makes more and more sacrifices for him.

title: Bhalobasa O Andhakar
description: Bhalobasa-O-Andhakar is a 1992 Indian Bengali film, directed by Dipranjan Bose and produced by Bhalobasa-O-Andhakar Roy. The film stars Sanchita Bose, Kushal Chakraborty and Satya Banerjee in lead roles. Music of the film was composed by Goutam Chatterjee.

title: O Governante Supremo
description: O protagonista, dotado de superpoderes, fica ainda mais forte após um período de cultivo. Ele derrota e elimina todos os vilões que antes o intimidavam. Para salvar sua mãe, ele enfrenta inúmeros perigos. No final, ao reunir a força de seu povo, ele supera a rebelião e se torna o líder supremo.

title: Shangoul o Mangoul
description: On a field trip a young schoolteacher named Mary [Afsaneh Bayegan] tells the story Shangoul and Mangoul to the children: The lion, as king of the jungle, sets up a contest between the wolf and the fox where he will hire the one who brings him delicious food the soonest. The wolf and the fox kidnap the baby goats (Shangoul, Mangoul and Grape). The wolf decides to eat Shangoul and Mangoul himself but the fox takes Grape to the lion. The mother goat goes looking for her children and she and other the animals of the forest restrain the wolf and the fox; the baby goats are returned to their mother safe and sound.

title: Entre Dois Alfas: O Passado vs. O Presente
description: Com dezoito anos, fui obrigada a escolher um dos filhos do Alfa como meu companheiro. Na vida passada, escolhi Cain — um grande erro. Ele me destruiu por completo. Desta vez, escolhi Casey, o de sangue frio, o mais brutal de todos. O que eu não esperava era que Cain também tivesse voltado.

title: Segunda Chance: O Caminho para o Bilhão(Dublado)
description: Na vida passada, Henrique usou os quatro milhões ganhos na loteria para fingir ser herdeiro e entrar na elite. Achou que conhecer poderosos mudaria seu destino, mas, dez anos depois, foi desmascarado e humilhado em público. Ao despertar, descobre que renasceu e voltou ao verão do último ano escolar. Com os quatro milhões, lucra com oportunidades na madeira, nos futuros de borracha e no petróleo. Desta vez, não vai fingir ser rico: vai construir a própria fortuna do zero!

title: Enchi o Banco do Além até o Limite
description:
Com a chegada do Submundo, Daniel Soares, que morreu nesse mundo em sua vida passada, renasce antes do evento com uma interface de jogo. Usando dinheiro ritual, ele abastece completamente sua conta no Submundo, adquirindo riqueza ilimitada.

Quando o Submundo finalmente desce sobre o mundo, Daniel usa sua fortuna infinita para forjar três artefatos divinos, evolui sua classe de ferreiro de nível D para Ferreiro Divino e, após três evoluções, ascende ao posto de Deus Criador. No fim, ele derrota o chefe final do mundo do Submundo.

title: Demon Lord, Retry!
description: On the night of his favorite game's shutdown, Akira Oono awakens in the body of his online character: Demon Lord Hakuto Kunai.

During the hectic Christmas season, the residents go about their lives while an old widower sits alone in his living room reading a card that says his son won't be coming home for Christmas. Meanwhile a dancer packs up her ballet shoes to give up on her dream in the big city. A financial consultant can't commit. An artist tries to confront his fear about talking to the girl upstairs. A washed up journalist can't find the right story. And three students more concerned with popularity than making friends all walk into an elevator. 8 strangers stuck in an elevator 8 stories high. 8 strangers are about to find out what being a true neighbor means.

title: An American Widow
description: Wealthy American widow Elizabeth Carter plans to marry the Earl of Dettminster when lawyer Augustus Tucker informs her of a codicil in her late husband's will. The Carter fortune will go to nephew Pitney Carter, who is in love with Elizabeth, if her second husband is not an American. Elizabeth therefore pays penniless playwright Jasper Mallory $50,000 to marry her and schemes with actress Mme. Albani to provide grounds for divorce so that she may then make the earl her third husband. The plan backfires when Jasper's play is a success and Elizabeth finds herself falling in love with him. title: Promesse à mon frère d'armes tombé au combat
description: Ares est un héros de guerre décoré des forces spéciales qui prend sa retraite après la mort au combat de son plus proche camarade. Hanté par le traumatisme, il est lié par une promesse : protéger la femme et la fille de son frère d'armes tombé au combat. Victimes d'une arnaque financière, elles se retrouvent criblées de dettes et terrorisées par des voyous locaux. Ares intervient avec une efficacité redoutable, avant de découvrir que ces hommes ne sont que du menu fretin. Derrière eux se cache un vaste réseau criminel composé de flics corrompus, de responsables véreux et de taupes militaires. Ils salissent sa réputation, lui tendent des pièges et tentent de le détruire. Mais il ne cède pas. Il réunit ses fidèles camarades, se bat sans relâche, démantèle le syndicat, éradique la corruption et blanchit son nom. Finalement, il tient sa promesse, venge les innocents et fait chuter tout ce système pourri, prouvant que le serment d'un seul homme peut renverser un empire bâti sur des mensonges.

title: Dream
description: Years ago, journalist Shen Yueshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now, she returns to Lacheng, picking up her camera again to explore those corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian were once the protagonists of her lens, yet their fates have been shaped by the passage of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time, and Shen Yueshui travels between the past and the present, uncovering these long-forgotten tales.

If you're a Class 3 student studying Hindi, you'll need some specific resources. The NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training) publishes textbooks for different subjects, including Hindi. For Hindi, there's a book called "Veena" designed for Class 3 students. You can find this book and other related materials online or in bookstores.

Aside from NCERT books, there might be new versions of textbooks released by your school or educational board. These are updated to include any changes or improvements in the curriculum.

description: Course Duration: 21 July 2025 - 30 Dec 2025 Validity: 31 Mar 2026 Online lectures. DPPs and Test With Solutions. Exam guidance at our PW Offline centers. In-person support and helpdesk at PW Offline centers. Subjects: EVS, Mathematics and English.

title: Crash Course Geology
description:
In 25 episodes, we’re going to learn about geology—the study of Earth’s physical structure and processes. Our host, Sage, will teach you about the geological forces and cycles that shape our planet’s past, present, and future. 

This content is based on an introductory university-level curriculum. By the end of this course, you should be able to: 

Trace Earth’s development from its earliest periods to its current structure
Understand the forces of plate tectonics and how they shape Earth’s landscape
Describe the formation of geologic elements like minerals, rocks, and gems 
Identify geologic forces and cycles that impact the earth, while dispelling myths about extreme geological hazards
Learn what geology reveals about Earth’s distant past and what it can teach us about our current changing climate
Explore the geology of other planets within the context of Earth’s unique and common qualities and phenomena
Become familiar with different specialities within geology and what different types of geologists do

Key texts cited include:
Marshak, Stephen. 2021. Earth: Portrait of a Planet, Seventh Edition.
Babcock, Loren E. 2009. Gemstones and Precious Metals.

title: Speak English Professionally: In Person, Online & On the Phone
description:
Do you want to speak better English? This course will help you reach that goal. Speak English Professionally: In person, Online and On the Phone will boost your English speaking skills. In this 5 week course, you will learn how to identify and make a strong personal introduction. You will develop and demonstrate the speaking skills for group discussions: how to agree or disagree, how to clarify, restate and summarize. You will review and practice how to give information and respond to requests on the phone. You will study and role play effective interviewing. You will prepare and give a sales “pitch”, introducing a product or service. Throughout the course, you will adjust how you speak English and you will become more fluent and accurate when you speak. You will demonstrate culturally appropriate body language and tone. As you work through the course, you will complete self- and peer-evaluations. Through a combination of lectures, comprehension and vocabulary quizzes, practice and performance, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to communicate well in English, anywhere in the world.	
By the end of this course you will:
• Change how you speak English
•	Improve your pronunciation and fluency 
• Increase your English vocabulary 
•	Identify how culture influences your speech
•	Use culture to help you speak correctly 
•	Demonstrate the best body language for different cultural settings
•	Know statements, questions and responses for different settings and situations

title: Introduction to HTML, CSS, & JavaScript
description:
Want to take the first steps to become a Web Developer? This course will help you discover the languages, frameworks, and tools you will need to create interactive and engaging websites right from the beginning. 
You’ll begin by understanding the roles of front-end, back-end, and full-stack developers and how they collaborate, along with the terminology and skills essential for a web development career. 
Next, you’ll dive deep into HTML5—learning about structural elements like section, article, header, footer, and form controls such as input, fieldset, and legend. You’ll also explore the Document Object Model (DOM), scripting basics, and browser compatibility. 
Moving on to CSS, you’ll learn how to style and format web pages using selectors, IDs, and classes. You’ll explore layout tools like Flexbox and gain hands-on experience with responsive design using frameworks such as Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap. In JavaScript, you'll learn about variables, control structures, functions, prototypes, and how to interact with the DOM, along with practical experience using APIs and client-side scripting techniques to enhance user interaction. 
By learning the fundamentals of HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, you will be able to combine them to: 
 - Create the basic structure of a website 
 - Create format and layout for web applications 
 - Enhance your website and create rich, interactive applications 
 - Increase user interactivity and enhance user experience 
 - Give your website a real wow factor! 
Throughout the course, you'll apply your learning through numerous hands-on labs and conclude with a final project where you'll build a webpage to showcase your skills and strengthen your portfolio.

title: C for Everyone, Part 1: Programming Fundamentals
description:
This course is for everyone. In the new world we live in, coding is a universally valuable skill, whether you're a scientist, artist, or a humanist. Algorithms are everywhere, and we all have to understand how they work. The C language is particularly well suited as an introduction to coding: It's a tried-and-true language, and it allows you to understand computing processes at a deep level. 
This course is the first part of a two-course sequence. It is a hands-on introduction to programming in C, designed to guide learners step by step from the basics of syntax and data types to more advanced concepts such as control flow, functions, recursion, arrays, and pointers. Through video lessons, quizzes, programming exercises, and real debugging tasks, learners build foundational concepts and good coding practices. By the end, learners will be able to write clear C programs, debug effectively, and build the knowledge base needed for more advanced computer science and software development.

title: Scratch in Hindi
description:
आज की दुनिया में कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग की समझ एक महत्वपूर्ण कौशल बन गयी है. कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग, जिसको कोडिंग भी कहते हैं, नियोजनीयता बढ़ाने में भी साकारत्मक भूमिका निभाती है। कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग करने से logical thinking भी विकसित होती है. 

कुछ वर्षों पहले, अमेरिका की MIT यूनिवर्सिटी के MIT Media Lab ने बच्चों में कोडिंग की रूचि जागृत करने के लिए Scratch नाम की एक फ्री सॉफ्टवेयर बनाई थी. Scratch अब बहुत प्रचलित हो गयी है और करोड़ों बच्चे, अध्यापक और अभिभावक आज Scratch के users हैं. 

Scratch में बहुत सरल block-based programming के ज़रिये आप मस्त games, animation और interactive stories इत्यादि बना सकते हैं. Scratch के नए version 3.0 में कई नए advanced features भी हैं जैसे Artificial Intelligence. 

इस वीडियो श्रृंखला में आप सीखेंगे free software Scratch में प्रोग्रामिंग.

title: Car God Returns
description: Apni asli pehchaan se anjaan ek talented mechanic ki zindagi tab badal jaati hai jab uski girlfriend usse dhokha de deti hai aur ek powerful CEO usse contract marriage kar leti hai. Jab sach saamne aata hai ki wahi desh ke sabse bade automobile empire ka asli waaris aur legendary "Car God" hai, to use apna haq wapas paane aur apne dushmano ko unki aukaat dikhani hoti hai.

title: The Teen Queen
description: The Teen Queen is a youth college drama about identity, privilege, and class divide. When billionaire heiress Tanisha Merchant hides her identity to live as an ordinary student, a poor girl, Mahira, is mistaken for the real heiress and embraces the lie. As one girl gives up her wealth and the other steals it, a fierce rivalry unfolds, testing love, friendship, and the true meaning of worth. Watch now!

title: The Ancient Water Pot changed My Life
description: After being betrayed and thrown out of his family, a wealthy young man discovers his mother’s magical water pot connects him to Lata, a village girl living in 1975. Using knowledge from the future, they transform each other’s lives and fall in love across 51 years. But when their connection is destroyed, Sahil discovers that the love he was searching for may have been beside him all along.

title: Love Beneath Paris Skies
description: When a fiery billionaire heiress is forced to work with a rugged ex-army driver in Paris, their constant clashes turn into an unexpected romance. But as a ruthless family conspiracy, deadly attacks, and a shocking contract marriage threaten their lives and the Oberoi empire, they must decide whether to trust each other—or lose everything they love

title: Mission Admission
description: A billionaire father, Sudeep Sahani, disguises himself as a poor man to protect his daughter from humiliation in an elite school. As class prejudice, betrayal, and greed unfold, his ex-wife Anjana and her partner Tony try to exploit him. Sudeep exposes their truth, fights injustice, and challenges the system with his mission of equal education for all. Watch now.

title: Scientist Ki Waapsi
description: When a brilliant but humble scientist is falsely accused by a fame-hungry influencer, he must fight a ruthless social media trial, powerful enemies, and public humiliation to reclaim his name and complete a mission that could change India's future.

title: Dil Ka Encounter
description: Dil Ka Encounter follows Ishaan Raghuvanshi, a haunted ex-sniper, and Sara Khanna, a billionaire’s daughter turned cadet after a life-changing rescue. Under a hidden identity, Sara joins a Special Forces academy—only to meet Ishaan, now broken and in hiding. As deception, rivalry, and power games unfold, a dangerous bond forms between them. This isn’t just action—it’s a battle between love and duty, past and redemption. Will Ishaan rise again… or lose everything once more? Watch now!

title: The Return of the Ultimate Mom
description: Watch this show live on KuKuTV now!

title: Pyar ka Turbulence
description: A pregnant woman fights for her life on a turbulent flight—only to discover her pilot husband abandoning her for another woman. After losing her baby and being framed as a murderer, she rises from betrayal and heartbreak to reclaim her power… returning as a mysterious aviation titan determined to expose the lies that destroyed her life.

title: Oops, Not a Gold Digger [Hindi]
description:
A fearless delivery girl’s good deed spirals into an accidental marriage with a man she believes to be penniless—unaware he’s heir to a billionaire empire.
As family secrets, jealous rivals, and office politics threaten her dreams, she must fight for dignity, ambition, and love.
A tale of hidden identities, chaotic matchmaking, and an unexpected romance that could change her life forever.

title: Codename Pyaar
description: Ek low-profile genius AI engineer, jise sab bewda aur muftkhor samajhte hain, asal mein India ki self-drive car ka asli hero hai—and jab system uske bina collapse karta hai, tab sach aur jhoot ka sabse khatarnaak test shuru hota hai.

title: Boss Ishqq aur Deal
description: A divorced single mother, Isha, lies to become the PA of billionaire Karan Ahuja to save her daughter’s custody. What begins as hatred, ego clashes, and a reckless bet slowly turns into love. But conspiracies, betrayals, and deadly attacks threaten to destroy everything. Watch now.

title: Billionaire Doctor Ka Ishq
description: Manisha’s life is shattered when she discovers she is pregnant after being drugged and spending a night with a stranger. As fear and confusion give way to shocking truth, she learns the man involved is a powerful billionaire. Caught between trauma, secrecy, and social judgment, Manisha must navigate a world that questions her character while she struggles to reclaim control over her body, dignity, and future.

title: Beghar Billionaire
description: Armaan Raheja, a billionaire disguised as a beggar, and Kashish, a kind-hearted girl with simple dreams, find themselves bound by fate, lies, and love. What starts as a contract marriage to fulfill a grandmother’s last wish soon turns into an emotional journey where truth, betrayal, and destiny test their hearts. Watch Now!

title: Time Travel [Hindi]
description: After betrayal and heartbreak, Rahul mysteriously travels back in time, determined to change his fate, save his family, and protect Alia from powerful enemies only to discover that altering the past comes with dangerous new consequences. Watch Now!

title: The Richest Bank Robber
description: When billionaire Adarsh Sharma returns to India, a sudden accident leaves his parents critically injured. Stripped of proof of identity, he is ridiculed and denied access to his own wealth. As time runs out, desperation turns into rebellion, forcing him into a daring heist of his own bank. Amid greed, ego, and injustice, the story unfolds as a gripping tale of survival, identity, and moral reckoning. Watch Now.

title: Desh ka Dhurandhar
description: Kabir, a fearless undercover operative known by his codename Agent Vajra, lives a double life defined by loyalty and sacrifice. When the President’s daughter is attacked by ruthless goons, Kabir steps in without hesitation, saving her in a high-risk rescue that exposes a larger conspiracy against the nation. At the same time, he is shattered by his wife’s betrayal—but even after discovering her deception, he refuses to let personal pain cloud his duty. When she is kidnapped by a terrorist from a hostile foreign country, Kabir risks everything to rescue her, proving that his sense of honor rises above heartbreak. In a gripping climax, he thwarts an assassination attempt on the President, dismantles the terror network, and emerges as a true patriot who places his country above all, earning the title of a selfless national hero.

title: Social Media ka Billionaire
description: A humble pizza delivery boy discovers he is the secret heir to an 8,000-crore empire but instead of revealing the truth, he chooses to stay poor and test the world that humiliated him.

title: CEO Bana Ghar Jamai
description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO.Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel.Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

title: Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions [Hindi]
description: "Pick a Dad to Inherit My Billions" A wealthy young heir sets out to “audition” potential father figures to inherit his fortune. As eccentric candidates compete for the role, hidden motives, heartfelt bonds, and unexpected twists blur the line between family and fortune.

title: Oops, It Was My Husband [Hindi]
description: Three years after a contract marriage, ambitious designer Isha Shrivastava unexpectedly crosses paths with her estranged husband, billionaire Nitin Mehta the man she never really knew. What begins as a fake relationship to escape family debts spirals into real emotions, shocking secrets, and a second chance at love neither of them saw coming. Watch Now!

title: My Accidental Royal Husband [Hindi]
description: In a twist of fate, a common woman accidentally marries a royal heir, unaware of his true identity. As she navigates palace intrigue and royal duties, their bond deepens, leading her to discover unexpected love and power.

title: Crystal's Greatest Creation
description:
This story is a compelling exploration of hidden identities, love, and self-worth set against the backdrop of wealth and ambition. It challenges the idea of whether love can survive without truth and equality. The narrative follows two individuals who reject their powerful identities, only to rediscover themselves through each other.
Blending romance, drama, and high-stakes business conflict, the show presents a layered world of deception, family politics, and emotional transformation. At its core, it is a story of a woman’s journey from being an unseen force behind success to owning her power unapologetically.
With themes of betrayal, reinvention, and partnership, the show balances mass appeal with a modern, aspirational tone.

title: Just Divorced
description:
A poor but self-respecting girl discovers that her absentee father is a powerful billionaire who refuses to acknowledge her.
Public humiliation, betrayal, and emotional abandonment shatter her childhood belief in love and family.
As a mother-daughter duo walks away from injustice, fate begins to test the father with guilt, loss, and truth.
This is the story of broken promises, hidden identities, and a daughter who refuses to beg for her father’s love.

title: Brahmrakshas
description: When a wedding in the silent village of Dhumgarh breaks an ancient taboo against noise, a curse awakens—the vengeful spirit of Dev, a once-noble scholar betrayed in love and transformed into the dreaded Brahmrakshas. As brides mysteriously vanish, Ira, a fearless paranormal expert, arrives to uncover the truth.

title: Paralysed Dulha [Hindi]
description: Boss, Open Up Your Eyes is a high-stakes drama of love, betrayal, and hidden identities. When Swati is forced into a contract marriage with Abhinav, a powerful heir who wakes up from a coma, secrets begin to unravel—her true identity, his family’s ruthless motives, and a dangerous game of power. Between manipulation, revenge, and unexpected emotions, both must decide whether this marriage will destroy them or become their greatest strength.

title: My Commando Wife
description: A humiliated housewife, secretly a legendary Marine Commando presumed to be a myth, rises from betrayal and erasure to reclaim her identity, destroy the family that discarded her, and prove that the woman they broke is the very warrior they were never worthy of.

title: The Miracle Surgeon
description: A selfless man who sacrifices his legendary medical career to become a househusband for his wife and daughter is humiliated, cheated on, and brutally divorced only to lose custody of the child he raised as his own. Years later when he returns as India’s most celebrated surgeon, the very medical genius the world worships. Fate pits him against his past when the child he loved faces a life-or-death surgery—and the family who destroyed him must now beg the man they once crushed to save her life

title: Ruthra Thandavam
description: Ruthra Thandavam

title: Mafia's Innocent Bride [Tamil]
description:
Don David rules the dark underworld of Chennai. His word is law, his eyes spell death.

When Meera is pulled into his ruthless world, she faces blood, betrayal, and revenge at every turn.

The throne of power is up for grabs. The war has just begun. 🔥

Every moment a riddle. Every scene a shock. Witness it Now!

title: Me and My Sister [Tamil]
description: ஒரு போர்ல நல்லா அனுபவப்பட்ட ஒரு சோல்ஜர், ஒரு அழகான, பவர்ஃபுல் CEO-க்கு பர்சனல் பாடி கார்டா மாறறான். மறைஞ்சிருக்கும் ஆபத்துல இருந்து அவளைக் காப்பாத்துறான், அதே நேரம் பெரிய சதித்திட்டங்களையும் கண்டுபிடிக்கிறான். இந்த குழப்பத்துக்கு நடுவுல காதல் மலர, அவனோட பலமும் விசுவாசமும் கொடூரமான எதிரிகள், அப்புறம் கார்ப்பரேட் சதிக்கு எதிரா சோதிக்கப்படுது..அந்த சோதனையில இருந்து தப்பிச்சானா??

title: Battle of Billionaire  [Tamil]
description: Paarth Singh is the new MD of Singh Group but he has hidden his identity from everyone, even from his wife and in-laws. He visits them for his father in-law’s birthday celebration where they demean and insult him. Will he finally reveal his true identity during this crisis? Watch Now !

title: Rented Husband [Tamil]
description: Rented Husband

title: My Fiancé Is A Bigshot
description: Divya returns to Chennai hiding her true identity. Betrayed and publicly humiliated by her lover Guru, she is pushed to the edge. A chance encounter with Kishore, a powerful CEO fighting his own battles, changes everything. When Divya’s real strength is revealed, those who mocked her are left helpless. This is the rise of a true Lady Boss.

title: After divorce, my wife become a trillionaire [Tamil]
description: Time Travel and historical movie . After a bitter divorce, a man watches in shock as his ex-wife rises to become a trillionaire overnight. Now, the tables have turned—and so has the game of love, power, and regret.

title: Rocket Tycoon [Telugu]
description: A man learns a woman has last-stage lung cancer and needs treatment within three days. A misunderstanding makes her think he is the patient, leading her to panic over money, insult him, and end the relationship. After a time jump, a young scientist wins a major award, but a powerful businessman and his son disrupt the ceremony, forcing the man to intervene and assert his influence.

title: Tapasya vs Temptation [Telugu]
description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

title: The CEO Son-in-Law
description: Thrown out by his wife and family, Abhimanyu is mocked as a useless man—unaware to them he is actually a powerful hidden CEO. Betrayed and humiliated, Abhimanyu begins his rise back to the top as secrets, mistaken identities, and family conflicts unravel. Now revealed, he must decide whether to reclaim his love or walk away forever after exposing the truth.

title: Mom is not Ugly [Telugu]
description: A self-sacrificing mother confronts her ungrateful son and his disdainful family, with help from the man she once saved, leading to a powerful lesson in humility and redemption.

title: The Prince [Kannada]
description: A billionaire in disguise marries a simple woman to discover the true meaning of love. But when her family’s doubts and a ruthless rival’s obsession threaten to tear them apart, he must fight harder than ever. A heartfelt saga of deception, loyalty, and the triumph of love over greed.

title: Love Mocktail
description: Aditya’s life shatters when his girlfriend leaves him on their wedding day for a richer man. In a twist of fate, he impulsively marries Preeti Shetty, a strong and mysterious woman. What begins as a sudden marriage turns into a journey of love, betrayal, and destiny. As secrets unfold, Aditya discovers he is actually Siddharth Sharma, the lost heir of a powerful family, leading to a battle for identity, love, and legacy.

title: Tapasya vs Temptation [Kannada]
description: Vihaan, the billionaire heir who has turned away from wealth and desire, wants to embrace sanyas. His powerful family, desperate to bring him back on the path of business and legacy, brings Rhea into his life - a desirable and clever woman tasked with seducing him. As Vihaan struggles between tapasya and temptation, Rhea finds herself caught in the mansion’s web of conspiracies and hidden desires. Will Vihaan hold on to his vow of restraint, or will temptation claim him forever?

title: Youngest Secret Billionaire [Kannada]
description: A struggling youngster, dismissed by society, dares to dream beyond limits. Through relentless hustle, bold risks, and defying betrayals, he transforms his failures into steppingstones. Against all odds, he rises from anonymity to shocking the world as the youngest secret billionaire, a tale of grit, ambition, and destiny fulfilled. Watch now.

title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World [Hindi]
description: Reborn as nobility with the power to size up talent in a glance, Ars Louvent is on a mission to elevate his new life.

title: PSYЯEN [Hindi]
description: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya-who possessed the same card-suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as "Psyren." When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins-one that will change his fate forever.

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN [Hindi]
description:
A boy fights... for "the right death."

Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.

Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with the Double-Faced Specter. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojou Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo Metropolitan Technical High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode received an early web premiere on September 19th, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 3rd, 2020.

title: A Housewife? I'm a Warrior!
description: A Housewife? I'm a Warrior!

title: A Suitcase for a Corpse
description: A man fantasizes about killing his wife. When he receives an anonymous letter with information that his wife is cheating on him, he decides to come up with a plan making his fantasies come true.

title: A Woman Is a Woman
description: A French striptease artist is desperate to become a mother. When her reluctant boyfriend suggests that his best friend impregnate her, feelings become complicated when she accepts.

title: A Goat for a Vote
description: The best way to understand our society is to look at one's children. Three students in Kenya compete to become the next school president. Winning the election not only gives them the possibility for power and respect, but guarantees them a future in Kenyan society. Magdalene, has to prove herself in a boy dominated school which has never been led by a girl. She has the impossible task to unite all girls in her fight for equal rights. Harry, from a poor family, hopes to win so he can take care of his family in the future. He struggles against the popular Said who is a natural born leader with a disarming smile.

title: A Moment, A Kiss, A Forever Love
description: After a divorce triggered by her husband's infidelity, Jessie Rowe forms a bond with Erickson Gray, a model, hoping to fulfill her greatest desire—a child of her own. What she doesn't realize is that Erickson, the man she believes she chose, has secretly admired her for years and orchestrated their meeting. Just as Jessie begins to develop feelings for Erickson, her vengeful ex-husband makes a move to complicate things.

title: A Kill for a Kill
description: A deceptive motivational speaker becomes entangled in a deadly game with a fan who suggests they kill each other's spouses.

title: A színésznö és a halál
description: Young actress Kathleen Gáti recalls the eight months - filled with love, suffering, understanding and acceptance - during which she cared for her dying mother. An uplifting and moving spiritual journey from despair to reassurance. Director Gábor Dettre and his then-wife Kathleen Gáti, an actress, talk in a forest about the eight months Kathleen spent caring for her dying mother.

title: A Whale of a Tale
description: Young Joey wants to be an animal trainer so badly that he sneaks into off-limits areas of Marineland.

title: A Concerto Is a Conversation
description: A virtuoso jazz pianist and film composer tracks his family's lineage through his 91-year-old grandfather from Jim Crow Florida to the Walt Disney Concert Hall.

title: A Bullet for a Stranger
description: A mysterious gunfighter decides to protect a pair of naive brothers after they unwittingly clash with a gang of extortionists.

title: A Wing and a Prayer
description: An air traffic controller guides a disabled plane.

title: A House Is Not a Home
description: Ben (Webb) and Linda Williams move the family into a dream home in a last ditch effort to save their troubled marriage. Despite their good intentions, they cannot shake the feeling that they are being watched by something. Their unimaginable fears are realized when things inside the house take a supernatural and sinister turn. Ben and his family flee for their lives, but it is too late. The house isn't finished with them, trapping the family in its labyrinth. The Williams must come together as never before to fight for their family, their lives and to escape.

title: A House on a Hill
description: Harry is an irascible, aging architect trying to achieve the dream of building his masterwork. A wealthy young couple has commissioned Harry to design and rebuild a house he once owned that had burned down. Though reluctant at first, he eventually takes on the assignment and develops a new sense of purpose when his ex-wife Mercedes gives him her blessing. Harry soon realizes that the work has tapped into the vigor and promise of his youth. In the meantime Gaby has been hired to make a documentary about Harry--her project helps to reveal a complex man who, because of personal tragedy, has never attained the greatness most people felt he was destined for.

title: A Tale of a Naughty Girl
description: Based on a short story by Bengali writer Prafulla Roy, the central idea developed by director Dasgupta, tells the story of a girl, Lati, whose mother Rajani is a prostitute living and working in a brothel in rural India. Rajani plans to offer her daughter to an older man, a rich husband and protector to her daughter. Lati, however, wants to return to school and finish her studies. Unwilling to pay such a price for material success, she runs away to Calcutta. The discovery of this new world is described parallel to other stories of emancipation, such as that of three young prostitutes, of an aged couple going nowhere and man's n landing on the moon. In a surrealistic approach typical of the director, a clumsy cat and an intelligent donkey are also present in the film.

title: A Man with a Maid
description: A Victorian aristocrat buys a former madhouse and converts it into a "love nest". Unknown to him, Jack the Ripper lives in secret passages lining the building.

title: A Bridge to a Border
description: When a man crosses a bridge, he faces a border. Pakal Gomez, ex- border patrol officer, railroaded into prison for a crime he did not commit, turns to terror as the last chance to wake up America. A gripping character study of rebels with and without a cause...

title: A Flecha e a Farda
description: The documentary begins with the 2012 discovery of silent registers of members of the GRIN (Rural Indigenous Guard) parading in uniform in 1970. It proceeds as an investigation into this all-indigenous militia group, founded and trained by Brazil's most recent military dictatorship, whose ranks were never formally dissolved. From study of archival material and present-day meetings with former GRIN members and their families unfolds a bifurcated reflection on the legacy of the dictatorship and the place of indigenous people in Brazilian society, one in which past and present hold equal weight.

title: A Night at a Honeymoon
description: Gaston wants more than anything to marry the naive Simone. But where he is, there is Sidonie, a local singer romantically pursued by the police commissionaire.

title: A Fuga, a Raiva, a Danca, a Bunda, a Boca, a Calma, a Vida da Mulher Gorila
A Ball & A Dream
description: The NBAs #1 Draft pick Malik Hall is town. Eli is the neighborhood street ball legend. Looking to prove his toughness, Malik sees beating Eli as a way to prove himeself. When these two ball players collide and one of them wont make it.

title: A Cura
description: A young medical doctor discovers some paranormal abilities. He can operate people with the assistance of the spirits of dead people.

title: A Family
description: A shocking drama about a couple which debates between business, love and life.

title: A House Without a Home
description: A marriage hits trouble when the husband loses his job while his wife achieves career success.

title: A Beggar? A Miracle Doctor!
description: A Beggar? A Miracle Doctor!

title: A Road to a Village
description: A road constructed in a village brings development, opportunities but at some cost.

title: A Wedding, A Forgotten Debt
description: Three years ago, Martha Hale’s husband and son died saving everyone in their building during an earthquake. But neighbor Rita Kerr soon forgot their sacrifice and even saw Martha as “bad luck.” Now, as Rita’s son Dylan Crowe prepares for his wedding, Martha decides to make everyone face the truth: honoring the dead means honoring life, and gratitude should never be forgotten.

title: A Bargain for a Bargain
description: The life of the twin brothers Kashkin has developed in different ways: one lives in the capital and has quite succeeded as a fashionable - bathhouse attendant. The other remained in his native village as a simple fishery inspector.

title: A Herdeira vs. A Falsa
description: Ela e o namorado estavam em um relacionamento à distância há quatro anos. Após o ensino médio, ela foi estudar no exterior e, para que ele não se sentisse inseguro com sua origem modesta, manteve em segredo o status de sua família rica, fingindo vir de uma família comum e alegando que estava estudando fora com empréstimos estudantis. Durante os quatro anos separados, ela sempre acreditou no amor dele por ela. No entanto, em uma reunião de volta para casa, ela o viu de braços dados com a filha adotiva de sua família, e naquele momento, suas ilusões se desmancharam. A filha adotiva estava usando o nome da família em benefício próprio, posando como a verdadeira herdeira. Na reunião, ela e um grupo de colegas a zombaram e humilharam, mas a verdadeira herdeira não estava mais se escondendo—ela chamou os três irmãos, que rapidamente colocaram todos em seus lugares.

title: B

title: B2: Stealth at War
description: The most expensive and specialized airplane ever built, the B2 Stealth bomber carries a price tag of more than two billion dollars. Highly effective and extremely technically advanced, it has been an integral part of the Air Force arsenal for the past 20 years. From a Cold War scrap heap candidate, to the go-to bomber in the 2011 strike against Qaddafi's army in Libya, "Spirit" has seen its share of trials and triumphs. Join us as we detail how this secret weapon evolved to overcome critics, espionage, and even tragedy, to change the shape of aviation forever.

title: Jae-seok's B&B Rules!
description: Yu Jae-seok ventures into running a B&B alongside Lee Kwang-soo, Byeon Woo-seok, and Ji Ye-eun. The staff and guests create memorable moments filled with laughter and genuine connections.

title: Plan B
description: A bookkeeper who thinks she killed three mobsters is subsequently promoted by her boss to be a hitman.

title: Iskushenie B.
description: The story of a writer who accidentally stumbles across the elixir of immortality and in doing so encounters the small group of immortals who have jealously guarded this secret for centuries.

title: King B.'s ROOST
description: Chicago Mafia Hit Man Alex Sims finds himself on the wrong end of the gun in this story about a hit man that gets hit by his own organization.

title: Dear Mummy B
description: A single mother's advice to her daughter's friend goes viral on the internet and turns her into a celebrity.

title: B-Roll
description: A disgraced local TV news reporter enlists the help of a wannabe journalist and a career film student to produce a documentary to revive his career.

title: B.F.F.

title: Ch/B

Kacey is looking both for her dog stolen by her ex-boyfriend and for her girlfriend who's dumped her. Kate decided to break up with Stevie and start living on her own.

title: C
description: The Japanese government was rescued from the brink of financial collapse by the Sovereign Wealth Fund.

title: Me & Mrs. C.
description: A young black female ex-convict becomes a boarder with the elderly white Mrs. Conklin in an effort to turn her life around. The two women take to each other immediately as the show chronicles their adjustments to and episodes with each other.

title: Love Between Fairy and Devil
description: A fairy whose tribe was in war with Moon Demon Lord, Qingcang meets him and mutual incantation and mutual curse ties their lives.

title: Ancient Lords
description: Time traveler Meng Qi only wants to be a merry and graceful swordsman, but he suddenly becomes the world-renowned "Mad Monk" in accomplishing his repeated and unlimited mission in the "reincarnation space". However, all this turns out to be planned by a powerful ancient lord. The story tells how the invincible and funny monk makes his way around in the world of martial arts and becomes a legendary swordsman.

title: The Best of Studio C
description: A collection of the Best of Studio C. Come watch your favorite cast members in their greatest and funniest sketches. Playlists are organized by theme, such as Best of Christmas and Best of Back to School.

title: You Are My Secret
description: Lobby manager Xiao Ning and business star Yu Heng share a desire to marry soon. As childhood friends turned colleagues when Yu Heng becomes Xiao Ning's boss they navigate marriage and career together exploring life's meaning as newlyweds.

title: The Dragon King's Hot Valet is a runaway mommy
description: Five years ago, herbalist Cecilia slept with fire-poisoned Dragon King Evander and bore a half-dragon cub, Milo. To afford Milo's suppressant, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the king's manservant. Guarding her secret, she turns rival heiress Willow into a best friend. The king falls for his "male servant" and spirals into jealous self-doubt.

title: Enceinte des Triplés du Roi Dragon (Doublé)
description: Vendue par sa famille à des prétendants violents contre de l'eau magique, Amélie, servante renarde que l'on croyait stérile, tombe enceinte de triplés après une nuit avec un inconnu qui est en réalité le Roi Dragon, Édouard. Tandis qu'il la protège de sa famille, de ses rivaux et de collègues jaloux, une attaque destinée à la tuer révèle qu'elle est la princesse perdue du Clan des Loups à Neuf Queues. Les ennemis tombent ; Édouard la fait sienne comme reine.

title: The Elf Prince's Mute Mommy
description: Human girl Selena is framed by Elf Queen Walda, causing her to lose her memory and voice. She is sent to the hunter Edmund, who torments her for three years. Elf Prince Lucian searches for his mother after seeing her in his dreams and meets Selena in the forest. When wolves attack, Selena risks her life to protect him, and mother and son recognize each other by the matching flower-shaped birthmarks on their collarbones.

title: Awaken the Infinite Money System
description: In a world where money buys magic, broke Kai Seldon is crushed by billionaire heir Andre Sterling, who owns the Guild and his mother's debt. With Raven’s scheme, Kai turns ledgers into weapons, forces a rematch, and watches a whole Arena pay for a miracle as Sterling's empire collapses. Left with real power, he learns what money can’t buy: the choice to become more is yours alone.

title: Paranormal Highway
description: There are areas in the United States known for mysterious and unexplained phenomena, creating what are called paranormal hot spots. A team of investigators travels the country to experience and document these strange, unexplained events.

title: X-Ray Eyes, Billionaire Rise
description: When poor student Lincoln Cross is hit by campus queen Audrey Sterling, he suddenly gains powerful X-ray vision. His astonishing talent leaves gang heiress Vera Blackwood, stunning sisters Blair Leighton & Amber Collins, and the elegant Audrey Sterling utterly captivated. After all—who wouldn’t want a walking god of wealth? Adapted from a hit web novel.

title: General and I
description: Clever strategist Bai Ping Ting and prince-general Chu Bei Jie of rival kingdoms find themselves torn between loyalty to the country and their passionate love for each other.

description: A runaway bride finds refuge with a charismatic street racer. As their deal turns to love, a devastating connection from their past threatens to shatter their newfound happiness and force her to make an impossible choice.

title: Guess Who I Am [Hindi]
description: Song Yao who never misses a beat in punishing scumbags encounters the fake prince of Chengtian Group. Caught in a Smiths-like battle, the "unremarkable" girl with electrifying eyes and the liar "CEO" begin their story. Legend has it that there's such a person who makes rich scumbags quake in their boots because she never fails to make them suffer the consequences of their actions. This girl's name is Song Yao (Zhang Yuxi). It's all thanks to her fantastic assets in attracting the rich. Any person who is worth hundreds of millions will fall in love with her inextricably as long as he looks into her eyes. Yet no matter how powerful she is, there is a day when she will encounter her Waterloo. Song Yao's eyes fail to work on "Ji Chengchuan" who is the prince of Chengtian Group. Little does she know that this is entirely because the prince in front of him is an impostor named Qin Hao (Wang Ziqi). The meeting of the two "actors" is destined to be explosive.

title: A Marriage of Disguise, A Love So True
description: Gifted with a photographic memory, master copyist Claire Benson is forced to become a stand-in bride for a billionaire heir who hides a ruthless side behind his perfect smile. When her true identity is exposed, she is drawn into a deadly battle for the family empire and forced to play both sides. But the fake bride who entered the mansion as a pawn may become its true mistress, claiming both love and power.

description: Reborn after a brutal betrayal, Elven Princess Eileen vows revenge. She rejects the elite red dragon and chooses Kael, a broken-winged black dragon despised as a useless beast. The crippled beast everyone looked down upon reveals his true identity—the Sovereign Dragon King. Now, the ultimate vengeance begins.

title: Rise of the Invincible Healer
description: A prodigy of cultivation, Dean is trapped at the peak of the Foundation Establishment stage. His master, Aegis, orders him to descend from the mountain to find a woman marked with the "Path Seal", the key to breaking his limits. On his very first night down the mountain, Dean crosses paths with Victoria, CEO of CryoCore Group. By a twist of fate, he becomes her boyfriend, protecting her and her bestie. With unmatched medical skills and martial prowess, he dominates the city, crushes every enemy who crosses him, and rises to the pinnacle of power and success.

title: Legend of Xianwu [English] S1-S2
description: Banished after failing to protect his sect's medicine field, Ye Chen faces betrayal from peers and his lover. A heavenly flame helps him grow stronger as he fights opponents and forges a new path.

description: In the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms era, young Lu Ping escapes the wicked forces of Shanhai Tower and discovers his spiritual identity in a moment of enlightenment - or rather, his spiritual identities, as he becomes aware of six distinct souls revolving through his being. When Lu later begins to train and grow under his teacher's masterful guidance, he meets eternal brethren and earns the affection of the young miss Qin along the way. All is going well until a vision reveals his relationship to an unresolved crime in the martial arts world of a decade earlier.

title: Heir of the Hidden Flame
description: Dylan Palmer, Emperor of Corria, has a unique constitution that forbids him from growing close to women. During a visit, Emma Weber—hoping to bear his child and become empress—drugs him, unintentionally involving Nina Greer in her scheme. Nina ends up spending the night with Dylan, but he dismisses the encounter as a mere dream—until six years later, when he meets a child bearing the unique royal birthmark.

title: Rejected by My Family, Feared by the World
description: 21st-century business tycoon Julian Carter is reborn as Gordon Carter’s true son, only to be mocked, rejected, and betrayed by his own family. After being cast out, he starts over with just twenty taels of silver. Using modern knowledge, he builds Silver Works into the kingdom’s top trading house. As his empire rises, the family who abandoned him comes begging—but Julian refuses to look back.

title: Love in Time

title: The Wrath of Vajra
description: Before the West entered World War II, a Japanese death cult called the Temple of Hades is ordered to aid in the spiritual destruction of China. Their method - abduct their enemies' children and train them as killers for the Emperor. Young Vajra was especially gifted, but swears a secret oath of revenge when his brother dies. Now the greatest assassin in the temple, Vajra escapes to China and begins his quest to protect the innocent, and destroy the ones responsible for making him a living weapon. A former Shaolin monk, martial arts action star Xing Yu (aka Shi Yanneng) stars as Vajra in his first leading role.

title: My Sunshine in the Ruins
description: Orphaned nurse Anna Hill faces life with unwavering optimism, brightening every life she touches—until she meets Elias Black. Hardened by his brutal upbringing in the slums, Elias believes he is living in hell, but Anna's light begins to crack his cold shell.

title: The Epoch of Miyu
description: On her 10th wedding anniversary, Miyu Xu realizes her perfect marriage is a facade and files for divorce. She starts anew as a room attendant at the Purong Hotel, where Feng Ji, now the general manager, returns to his roots. As they face professional challenges, their support for each other grows into romance, leading to personal happiness and the transformation of the hotel into a Shanghai landmark.

title: Boxers Bullied the Gym Cleaner, Never Expecting He Was a 30-Year Boxing Emperor—One Punch, All Down!
description: 🔥 Welcome to VORTEX DRAMA! ⚡ Daily High-Stakes Thrills • Epic Showdowns • Heroes Defying Odds → FOLLOW for Adrenaline-Fueled Adventures! WE DELIVER: 💥 Action | 🕵️♂️ Suspense | 🚀 Sci-Fi/Fantasy | 💪 Heroic Journeys Boxing King Long Taisen wins the Grand Championship, but his defeated rival Green harbors a deadly grudge and murders his father in revenge. Honoring his father’s dying wish, Long Taisen quits the boxing world, seals his immense power with iron rings, and lives in obscurity while raising his daughter, Long Chuchu, alone. Twenty years later, the Long Boxing Gym thrives under Chuchu’s leadership, while the once-legendary champion works quietly as a janitor in his own gym. When the Grand Championship is revived and the nation’s only qualification spot is granted to the Long Gym, Long Chuchu insists on competing—once again facing the ruthless underground fighters from Nanyang. Bound by his father’s final command, will the former King of Boxing finally remove the iron rings and step back into the ring? 👉If you like this video, please like, comment, and subscribe!🎬🎉 #shortdrama #fullepisode #hegemonic president #male frequency #male protagonist #rebirth #revolt #reversal #superpowers #revolutionary #encouragement #shortfilm #hotshortdrama #shortdramafull #revenge#kungfu #movies #shortplay #action #actionmovies #kungfumovies #chinesedrama#vortexdrama

title: Spices of Fate
description: Mandy Jones, a contestant in the modern Master Chef competition, unexpectedly finds herself transported to the olden times as a neglected concubine in the Regal Residence. There, her exceptional cooking skills quickly draw attention, and a romantic connection begins to blossom between her and Prince James Cavill after a series of misunderstandings.

title: Exiled to Emperor
description: Imperial Preceptor Hadrian Hale united Astoria, but after his betrayal by Empress Celia Vale, he was stripped of his titles and exiled. Escaping with 800 loyal guards, Hale crushed her assassins with ease. As enemies attacked from all sides, Hale rallied powerful factions—Northmarch, Huns, and more—defeating the Sunblessed Isle, Sunset Empire, Dragon Empire, and Sultanate of Tutan. He dismantled the Celestial Kingdom and wiped out the Primordia Sect, building an army of millions. Despite the Empress's arrogant attempts to humiliate him, Hale marched on the capital, using his immortal powers to subdue the Imperial Guards, crush her final resistance, and exile her. In the end, he claimed the throne and united the realm.

title: Sweet Combat
description: As the eldest daughter of the Fang Conglomerate, Fang Yu was raised to become the sole successor of the company, yet she goes against her family's wishes to pursue boxing.

title: The Legend in the Shadows
description: Ethan Sloan, a legendary ex-soldier and dark lord, is sent to protect cold, silent CEO Celine Blaker. Due to a misunderstanding, she mistakes him for a thug. But as Ethan resolves crisis after crisis, he effortlessly crushes all rival forces and slaps villains in the face. His unmatched strength and charm finally win her over, as he forges a passionate urban legend.

title: Five Elements Secret Art
description: The ancient people created the five secret arts based on the principle of the five elements, which are the five arts of gold, wood, water, fire and earth, and formed five corresponding sects. However, with the decline of the Golden Gate, the whereabouts of this secret treasure are not known. The Golden Gate heir, Yang Lao, with his son, Yang Yiqin, lives in anonymity in Taoyuan Town, playing iron and selling vegetables.

title: Commandant, j'épouse quelqu'un d'autre
description: Pendant cinq ans, Irene a aimé le Commandant Carson de toutes ses forces. Elle connaissait ses plannings de vol par cœur, achetait des billets juste pour être sur ses trajets, se réveillait à 2 h du matin pour ses atterrissages, et avait quitté son emploi à Seattle pour le suivre dans une ville où elle ne connaissait personne. Elle croyait qu'il allait la demander en mariage, qu'un jour il poserait un genou à terre dans le terminal sous les acclamations de la foule. Mais Carson ne l'a jamais considérée comme sa petite amie. Pour lui, Irene était pratique : une compagnie chaleureuse, toujours disponible, quelqu'un pour l'entraînement le temps de comprendre ce que voulait une vraie femme. Celle qu'il aimait réellement était Blair, une prostituée qu'il payait entre deux escales. Quand Irene a appris la vérité, son cœur ne s'est pas brisé : il s'est arrêté net. Elle n'a ni pleuré ni crié. Elle a souri, a pris une profonde inspiration, et a dit oui au gentil voisin qui l'aimait en silence depuis des années. Un an plus tard, Carson a découvert que Blair était une croqueuse de diamants impitoyable qui s'était toujours moquée de lui. Ruiné et brisé, il s'est présenté à la porte d'Irene, implorant ma belle qu'il avait jetée. Il arrivait dix mois trop tard. Irene n'a même pas levé les yeux en signant son acte de mariage.

title: Ivelisse vs Sin-D
description: Ivelisse spends the opening portion busting out an array of bodybuilding poses showing off her musculature while bragging about how great she looks. Sin-D, not to be outdone, precedes to show off her own physique with a series of stretches to warm up for the match. By the time the bell rings, each competitor is ready for action. Not surprisingly, the hot-tempered Ivelisse is the aggressor, hitting a strike to the face, applying a bodyscissors and throwing a series of well-placed kicks to her opponent. Ivelisse also puts Sin-D in some serious pain with both a Dragon Sleeper as well as stepping on SinD’s hair while pulling her off the canvas. Ouch! The offensive onslaught continues with Ivelisse simply dominating her opponent, with various holds, strikes and throws. Ultimately, Sin-D rolls to ringside in an act of self-preservation. Will she beat the count back into the ring?

title: Balhay e zendegi
description: This film is the true story of MahMonir, an unconventional Iranian woman. MahMonir was a successful pilot and parachuter before the revolution; she became an unknown farmer after the revolution. During her life she experienced terror and fear, sorrow and sadness. This story is about MahMonir with all the aspects of her soul, her attempt to be accepted in a paternal society , her love for humankind, her childhood. More, all the forces and limitations that religion and society have imposed on her makes her who she is today. Her passion for life has helped her to get through many hardships,giving us a picture of a truly amazing,woman.
